title: QH-GEM: Quantum-Hydrodynamic Generative Modeling
summary: In this paper, we develop a deterministic, physically constrained generative framework based on the Madelung formulation of the free-particle Schrödinger equation. A reference Born probability density and a controllable initial phase function serve as initial data for the free Madelung system, which couples the Born probability density and phase function through the Bohm quantum potential, while the phase function determines the hydrodynamic velocity field.
